statements:
CREATE TABLE order_history (
  history_id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  id UUID NOT NULL,
  _version BIGINT NOT NULL,
  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
  "data" JSONB NOT NULL,
  recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT order_history_pkey PRIMARY KEY (history_id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE order_history IS 'Version history for order'

steps.subject: table/order_history/index/uq_order_history_id_version
function/order_capture_history

hazards.reason: Seeding order_history writes one image of every row of order while the new triggers' lock blocks writes to it.
hazards.subject: table/order_history

statements:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_bump_version
  BEFORE UPDATE ON "order"
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION order_capture_history()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_capture_history_write
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON "order"
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION order_capture_history()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_capture_history_delete
  AFTER DELETE ON "order"
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION order_capture_history()

INSERT INTO order_history (id, _version, operation, data)
SELECT src.id, src._version, 'INSERT', to_jsonb(src) - ARRAY['note']
FROM "order" AS src
